economic.sentenceEn: Chicago's summer festivals are about more than just entertainment; they are economic engines that directly benefit the neighborhoods they're in and the city of Chicago as a whole.
economic.translationZh: 芝加哥的夏季音乐节不仅是娱乐活动，更是直接惠及所在社区乃至整个芝加哥市的经济引擎。
economic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

economic.sentenceEn: An economic survey of 700 U.S. taxpayers found that people would be willing to pay a significant amount of money to make sure the parks and their programs are kept intact.
economic.translationZh: 一项针对700名美国纳税人的经济调查显示，人们愿意支付可观的金额，以确保国家公园及其各项项目保持原样。
economic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

economic.sentenceEn: That's because economic growth can be correlated with environmental degradation, while protecting the environment is sometimes correlated with greater poverty.
economic.translationZh: 这是因为经济增长可能与环境退化相关联，而保护环境有时又与加剧贫困相关联。
economic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

economic.sentenceEn: Research by the World Economic Forum finds that on average 42 per cent of the "core skills" within job roles will change by 2022.
economic.translationZh: 世界经济论坛的研究发现，到2022年，各职业角色中平均42%的"核心技能"将会发生变化。
economic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

economic.sentenceEn: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
economic.translationZh: 针对这些众多单边措施，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）目前正与131个国家合作，以期在2020年底前就一项国际解决方案达成共识。
economic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

economic.sentenceEn: Technological innovation is integral to economic success.
economic.translationZh: 技术创新是经济成功不可或缺的组成部分。

effect.sentenceEn: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present.
effect.translationZh: 自20世纪50年代以来，影视制作便一直在流出好莱坞，但其影响从未像现在这样明显。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

effect.sentenceEn: "A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term," Castle said, "and so it's a cyclical effect ."
effect.translationZh: 卡斯尔表示：“众多从业者为旅游业提供服务，而旅游业又依赖短期游客来维持运转，因此形成了一种循环效应。”
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

effect.sentenceEn: The rules, which came into effect on Wednesday in England, are part of government plans to reduce the UK's carbon emissions to net zero by 2050.
effect.translationZh: 这些新规于周三在英格兰生效，是英国政府计划的一部分，旨在到2050年将英国的碳排放降至净零水平。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

effect.sentenceEn: However, the long-term effects of the changes will be more comfortable and energy-efficient homes, adds Andrew Mellor, of PRP architects.
effect.translationZh: 然而，PRP建筑事务所的安德鲁·梅勒补充道，这些变革的长期效果将是更舒适、更节能的住宅。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

effect.sentenceEn: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedures?
effect.translationZh: 《雇佣关系法》中关于不当解雇的条款可能会产生什么影响？

effect.sentenceEn: They show effects of different exposure times.
effect.translationZh: 它们展示了不同曝光时间带来的效果。

economy.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
economy.translationZh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失，并导致约25万个就业岗位流失。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

economy.sentenceEn: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress.
economy.translationZh: 剑桥大学经济学家黛安娜·科伊尔在其新书《齿轮与怪兽：经济学是什么，应该是什么》中指出，数字经济需要我们以新的方式思考进步。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

economy.sentenceEn: "Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past," she writes.
economy.translationZh: 她写道：“无论我们如何定义经济增长，如何理解境况改善，其成果的分配都必须比近年来更加均衡。”
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

economy.sentenceEn: Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.
economy.translationZh: 这不仅会引发政治和社会动荡，正如科伊尔所指出的，还可能阻碍区域经济增长所需的各类人工智能技术的发展。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

economy.sentenceEn: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK's net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity.
economy.translationZh: 虽然生产性植树能够为农村经济带来实实在在的经济效益，并有助于英国实现净零战略目标，但政府的支持重点仍然放在粮食生产以及仅以生物多样性为目的的荒野恢复和本土林地种植上。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

economy.sentenceEn: Pay greater attention to boosting rural economies .
economy.translationZh: 更加重视促进农村经济发展

evidence.sentenceEn: Librarians' selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cell phone and saying, "it's all in here" as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.
evidence.translationZh: 当用户举起手机说“所有信息都在这里面”，以此证明图书馆对当今研究人员不再那么重要时，图书馆员无私奉献的精神反而可能对我们不利。
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

evidence.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
evidence.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

evidence.sentenceEn: "We need better evidence on what makes drivers unsafe" and what can help, said Dugan.
evidence.translationZh: 杜根表示：“我们需要更充分的证据来了解导致驾驶员不安全的因素，以及哪些措施可以提供帮助。”
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

evidence.sentenceEn: Perhaps most importantly, these images provided documentary evidence that later made its way to government officials.
evidence.translationZh: 或许最重要的是，这些影像提供了文献证据，后来被呈交给了政府官员。

evidence.sentenceEn: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance, wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J. Simons.
evidence.translationZh: 例如，心理学家克里斯托弗·查布里斯(Christopher Chabris)和丹尼尔·J·西蒙斯(Daniel J. Simons)写道，目前尚无实验证据表明互联网会干扰我们的专注力。
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

evidence.sentenceEn: Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it differs so greatly from that of animals that so-called evidence of plants' intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
evidence.translationZh: 作者写道，植物生物学复杂而迷人，但其与动物生物学存在巨大差异，因此所谓植物拥有智能的证据并不确凿。
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

expert.sentenceEn: Yet even as scientists and public officials increasingly agree on the need for more fires in our forests, climate change is making this tactic more challenging, experts said.
expert.translationZh: 专家表示，尽管科学家和公职人员日益达成共识，认为我们的森林需要更多计划性火烧，但气候变化正使这一策略面临更大的挑战。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

expert.sentenceEn: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts .
expert.translationZh: 专家表示，RFI（意大利铁路网公司）多年来持续投入的高密度技术和卫星信号技术也将带来进一步的提升。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

expert.sentenceEn: In many cases the experts have a hard time agreeing on what is the real object and what is a forgery.
expert.translationZh: 在许多情况下，专家们也很难确定哪些是真品，哪些是赝品。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

expert.sentenceEn: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
expert.translationZh: 专家表示，在至少一项课外活动中展现才华有助于大学申请，尤其是在顶尖本科院校的申请过程中。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

expert.sentenceEn: Experts say it is tougher to distinguish oneself in a school-affiliated extracurricular activity that is common among high school students than it is to stand out while doing an uncommon activity.
expert.translationZh: 专家表示，在高中生普遍参与的学校附属课外活动中脱颖而出，要比通过一项不常见的活动崭露头角更加困难。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

expert.sentenceEn: However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in.
expert.translationZh: 然而，大学招生专家表示，准大学生课外活动的质量比其参与的活动数量更为重要。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

executive.sentenceEn: I have yet to meet a chief executive who reads regularly.
executive.translationZh: 我还没见过哪位首席执行官有定期阅读的习惯。

executive.sentenceEn: "Not only are we facing a carbon crisis now, but we will also be facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood," said Stuart Goodall, chief executive of Confor.
executive.translationZh: Confor首席执行官斯图尔特·古德尔表示：“我们现在不仅面临着碳危机，还将因未能植树产材而面临未来的建筑危机。”
executive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

executive.sentenceEn: High school students who have had a strong positive influence on their community through an extracurricular activity may impress a college and win a scholarship, says Erica Gwyn, a former math and science magnet program assistant at a public high school who is now executive director of the Kaleidoscope Careers Academy in Atlanta, a nonprofit organization.
executive.translationZh: 亚特兰大非营利组织万花筒职业学院执行主任埃丽卡·格温表示，通过课外活动对社区产生重大积极影响的高中生可能会给大学留下深刻印象并获得奖学金。她曾是一所公立高中的数学和科学磁铁项目助理。
executive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

executive.sentenceEn: "We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing," said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.
executive.translationZh: “我们的出租住房供应已处于危机水平，”大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行董事尼克·泰勒说道。
executive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

executive.sentenceEn: Brian Berry, chief executive of the Federation of Master Builders, says the measures will require new materials, testing methods, products and systems to be installed.
executive.translationZh: 英国建筑大师联合会首席执行官布莱恩·贝里表示，这些措施将要求安装新的材料、测试方法、产品和系统。
executive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

executive.sentenceEn: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives .
executive.translationZh: 但这些条款在适用于高薪管理人员和高管时，给企业带来了困难。
executive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

event.sentenceEn: Now, researchers have used genomes of over 200 donkeys to trace their domestication back to a single event around 7,000 years ago in East Africa — about 3,000 years before humans tamed horses.
event.translationZh: 现在，研究人员通过对 200 多头驴的基因组进行分析，追溯到它们的驯化起源于约 7000 年前东非的一次单一事件——这比人类驯服马的时间早了约 3000 年。
event.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

event.sentenceEn: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
event.translationZh: 研究团队重建了这些动物的进化树，并利用计算机模型精准定位了这次驯化事件，即肯尼亚和非洲之角的牧民驯服野驴的时间点。
event.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

event.sentenceEn: Though it's still unclear why the original domestication happened, Science News' Freda Kreier reports that the event coincided with the Sahara growing larger and drier.
event.translationZh: 尽管最初驯化的原因尚不明确，但《科学新闻》的弗雷达·克赖尔报道称，这一事件恰逢撒哈拉沙漠范围扩大且气候变得更加干旱的时期。
event.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

event.sentenceEn: What began as a small neighborhood gathering blossomed into a massive cultural event , welcoming tens of thousands of people each year over nearly two decades before abruptly shutting down.
event.translationZh: 这一起初只是小规模的邻里聚会，后来发展壮大成为一项盛大的文化盛事，在近二十年的时间里，每年都吸引数万民众参与，直到最后戛然而止。
event.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

event.sentenceEn: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
event.translationZh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。

emotional.sentenceEn: It's important to note that while AI can enhance our appreciation of beauty, it should not replace the genuine human experience and the emotional connections we derive from seeing the beauty in each other.
emotional.translationZh: 需要注意的是，虽然人工智能可以提升我们对美的欣赏，但它不应取代真实的人类体验，以及我们在彼此身上发现美时所产生的这种情感纽带。
emotional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

emotional.sentenceEn: A study found that a "rehearsal room" approach to teaching Shakespeare broadened children's vocabulary and the complexity of their writing as well as their emotional literacy.
emotional.translationZh: 一项研究发现，采用"排练室"式的莎士比亚教学方法，不仅能拓宽儿童的词汇量，提升其写作的复杂性，还能增强他们的情感素养。
emotional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

emotional.sentenceEn: The grammar school boy from Stratford-upon-Avon has landed a scholarly punch after groundbreaking research showed that Shakespeare does benefit children's literacy and emotional development.
emotional.translationZh: 一项开创性研究表明，莎士比亚的作品确实有助于儿童的识字能力和情感发展，这位来自埃文河畔斯特拉特福的文法学校男生就此给了学术界一记有力回击。
emotional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

emotional.sentenceEn: O'Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the " emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children's writing" and that they were "more resilient in their writing, more hopeful".
emotional.translationZh: 奥汉隆表示，她最惊讶的是“[目标]儿童作品中展现出的情感认知能力”，以及他们“在写作中表现出更强的适应力和更积极的希望”。
emotional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

emotional.sentenceEn: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
emotional.translationZh: 一位受访者表示：“艺术家帮助科学家接触更广泛的受众，并建立情感联系，从而促进学习。”
emotional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

emotional.sentenceEn: What can promote children's emotional literacy according to O'Hanlon?
emotional.translationZh: 根据奥汉隆的观点，什么可以促进儿童的情感素养？

ensure.sentenceEn: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
ensure.translationZh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
ensure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

ensure.sentenceEn: Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand.
ensure.translationZh: 英国林业协会现在呼吁为实现这些目标注入更大动力，以确保我们拥有足够的木材来满足日益增长的需求。
ensure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

ensure.sentenceEn: While the FTC is doing what it can to ensure apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of their sensitive health information, the rate at which these health apps are hitting the market demonstrates just how immense of a challenge this is.
ensure.translationZh: 尽管联邦贸易委员会正尽其所能确保应用程序履行对消费者在敏感健康信息处理方面的承诺，但这些健康应用程序涌入市场的速度表明，这是一项多么艰巨的挑战。
ensure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

ensure.sentenceEn: It added: "We prefer to help people and organisations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters. However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage, while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives."
ensure.translationZh: 政府补充道：“我们更倾向于帮助民众和机构做出正确选择，而非对此类事务进行立法。不过，人造草坪的使用必须遵守现行的法律和政策保障措施，以保护生物多样性并确保可持续排水，同时，像强化生物多样性义务这样的措施应有助于鼓励公共机构考虑可持续的替代方案。”
ensure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ensure.sentenceEn: In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that " ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."
ensure.translationZh: 今年3月，加利福尼亚州总检察长宣布批准《加州消费者隐私法》(CCPA)下的补充法规，这些法规将“确保消费者在行使其数据隐私权时不会被混淆或误导。该法规旨在禁止‘黑暗模式’——这意味着禁止公司使用模糊语言或设置不必要的步骤，例如强迫用户点击多个屏幕或听取不应选择退出的理由。”
ensure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

ensure.sentenceEn: It has ensured the coordination of protection efforts.
ensure.translationZh: 它确保了保护工作的协调统一。

earn.translationZh: 美国顾客历来会给那些他们认为主要靠小费收入的人小费，比如收入低于最低工资的餐厅服务员。
earn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

earn.sentenceEn: Postgraduates now earn 40 per cent more than graduates.

earn.sentenceEn: Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified "high-income threshold" from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.
earn.translationZh: 在塔斯曼海对岸，澳大利亚通过将收入超过特定"高收入阈值"的员工排除在不公平解雇法律保护范围之外，来解决这一不合理解雇的矛盾。
earn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

earn.sentenceEn: Remember that most bestselling authors began writing when they were doing other things to earn a living.
earn.translationZh: 要知道，大多数畅销书作家都是在从事其他谋生工作时开始写作的。
earn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

earn.sentenceEn: In France, shareholders who hold onto a company investment for at least two years can sometimes earn more voting rights in a company.
earn.translationZh: 在法国，持有某公司投资至少两年的股东有时可以获得更多的公司投票权。
earn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

earn.sentenceEn: Everything he achieved in life was earned the hard way and his success in the literary field was no exception.
earn.translationZh: 他一生中所取得的一切成就都是靠不懈奋斗换来的，在文学领域的成功也不例外。
earn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

employee.sentenceEn: But even with these policies in place, some employees choose to break the rules.
employee.translationZh: 但即便有了这些规定，仍有部分员工选择违反规则。
employee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

employee.sentenceEn: So, to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to the temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
employee.translationZh: 因此，为了在不提高价格的情况下增加员工工资，越来越多的雇主正屈服于小费蔓延和小费膨胀的诱惑。
employee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

employee.sentenceEn: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages, some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
employee.translationZh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
employee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

employee.sentenceEn: Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, "employers are having a hard time attracting employees , and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live," Taylor said.
employee.translationZh: 新罕布什尔州南部城镇缺乏足够的经济适用房，"雇主难以吸引员工，而员工也难以找到住处，"泰勒说。
employee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

employee.sentenceEn: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
employee.translationZh: 在组建增长团队之前，软件公司BitTorrent有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。
employee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

employment.sentenceEn: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
employment.translationZh: 虽然书籍过去是、且应当永远是图书馆的核心，但图书馆也提供许多其他服务，如就业咨询、语言课程以及数字化接入与支持。
employment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

employment.sentenceEn: This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment .
employment.translationZh: 这使得能力处于边缘水平的管理者更难找到工作。
employment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

employment.sentenceEn: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
employment.translationZh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
employment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

employment.sentenceEn: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages.
employment.translationZh: 即便没有将工作置于风险之中，就业保护法只要在一定程度上限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理人员，就会对企业生产力构成制约，进而影响工人工资。
employment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

employment.sentenceEn: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
employment.translationZh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
employment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

employment.sentenceEn: Women's need in employment should be considered.
employment.translationZh: 应当考虑女性在就业方面的需求。

exist.sentenceEn: This summer, as you enjoy your favorite neighborhood street festival, I hope you'll remember that they exist because of community support.
exist.translationZh: 今年夏天，当您尽情享受家门口的街道节庆时，希望您能记住，正是有了社区的支持，这些活动才得以存在。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

exist.sentenceEn: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I'd be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists .
exist.translationZh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏文献和数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家们有着同样的梦魇。如果说目前存在一个全面的保存解决方案，那我一定是在撒谎。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

exist.sentenceEn: Existing health privacy law, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, is primarily focused on the way hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online.
exist.translationZh: 现有的健康隐私法，如《健康保险流通与责任法案》，主要关注医院、医生办公室、诊所和保险公司在线存储健康记录的方式。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

exist.sentenceEn: Citation cartels, where journals, authors, and institutions conspire to inflate citation numbers, have existed for a long time.
exist.translationZh: 引文卡特尔（即期刊、作者和机构合谋抬高引文数量的行为）由来已久。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

exist.sentenceEn: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
exist.translationZh: 例如，高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政结构，尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

exist.sentenceEn: What does the author imply about existing health privacy law?
exist.translationZh: 作者对现有健康隐私法暗示了什么？

explore.sentenceEn: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
explore.translationZh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
explore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

explore.sentenceEn: They pool resources, collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science for the sake of science without the traditional boundaries of working inside a formal setting.
explore.translationZh: 他们汇聚资源、通力协作、跳出思维定式，在不受正式工作环境传统界限束缚的情况下，为了科学而探索科学，寻找解决问题的方法并克服各种障碍。
explore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

explore.sentenceEn: Chaudhary said that Britain should explore the possibility that older siblings helping their parents "might also enhance their own social development".
explore.translationZh: 乔杜里表示，英国应当探索让哥哥姐姐帮助父母照料弟妹这一可能性，这"或许也能促进他们自身的社会发展"。
explore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

explore.sentenceEn: Perhaps museums and governments might explore some role for the use of nearly exact reproductions as a means of resolving issues relating to returning works of art and antiquities.
explore.translationZh: 或许博物馆和政府可以探索利用近乎精确的复制品，将其作为解决艺术品和古物返还相关问题的一种途径。
explore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

explore.sentenceEn: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.
explore.translationZh: 半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院成立了高级视觉研究中心（CAVS），旨在探索科技在文化中的作用。
explore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

explore.sentenceEn: But it is an argument for exploring consequences first.
explore.translationZh: 但它确实说明，我们应当首先探究目标可能带来的后果。
explore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

essential.sentenceEn: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
essential.translationZh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
essential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

essential.sentenceEn: Without the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential in improving disabled access to buildings and helping provide general convenience to commercial buildings.
essential.translationZh: 自动门无需手动触碰即可开关，对于改善残障人士的建筑物出入条件以及为商业建筑提供普遍便利至关重要。
essential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

essential.sentenceEn: If customers are not willing to share data, AI will be starved of essential information and will not be able to function effectively or employ machine learning to improve its marketing content and communication.
essential.translationZh: 如果客户不愿意分享数据，人工智能将缺乏必要的信息，无法有效运作，也无法利用机器学习来改进其营销内容和沟通方式。
essential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

essential.sentenceEn: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
essential.translationZh: 的确，高中的编程课对于大学学习计算机科学并非必不可少。
essential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

essential.sentenceEn: What is essential to California's plan according to Paragraph 5?
essential.translationZh: 根据第五段，加州计划的关键是什么？

essential.sentenceEn: Accessing databases is essential to researchers.
essential.translationZh: 访问数据库对研究人员来说至关重要。

establish.sentenceEn: Established in an old paper mill, it is powered by a nearby river and its remote heat warms the people who live in the surrounding town of Kajaani.
establish.translationZh: 它建于一座旧造纸厂内，由附近的河流提供动力，其远程供暖系统为居住在周边卡亚尼镇的居民供暖。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

establish.sentenceEn: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established .
establish.translationZh: 俄亥俄州立大学允许学生们在校园中心的椭圆形草坪（the Oval）自由穿行，随后学校将这些学生们自然踩出的小径铺设成路，形成了一张由学生自行开辟的高效路线网络。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

establish.sentenceEn: When it was established , the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
establish.translationZh: 英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)成立之初便极具远见：提供高质量、及时的医疗服务，以满足其所服务人群的主要需求。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

establish.sentenceEn: The researchers first established what kinds of plant the elephants preferred either to eat or avoid when foraging freely.
establish.translationZh: 研究人员首先确定了大象在自由觅食时喜欢吃哪些植物以及会避开哪些植物。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

establish.sentenceEn: That March, President Ulysses S. Grant signed an act into law that established Yellowstone as the world's first national park.
establish.translationZh: 同年3月，尤利西斯·S·格兰特总统签署法案，正式将黄石确立为世界上第一个国家公园。

establish.sentenceEn: It is established to prevent citation manipulation.
establish.translationZh: 其设立旨在防止引文操纵。

educational.sentenceEn: There is no good reason that these artifacts should be beyond the ordinary reach of the educational objectives or inspiration of the generations to which they were left.
educational.translationZh: 没有充分理由让这些文物脱离其本应传承给的后代子孙的教育目标或灵感启迪的寻常可达范围。
educational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

educational.sentenceEn: "If you already know your major, having an extracurricular that fits into that major can be a big plus," says Mayghin Levine, the manager of educational opportunities with The Cabbage Patch Settlement House, a Louisville, Kentucky, nonprofit community center.
educational.translationZh: 肯塔基州路易斯维尔市非营利社区中心——卷心菜地定居之家的教育机会部经理梅金·莱文表示：“如果你已经确定了自己的专业，那么参加与该专业相关的课外活动将会是一个很大的加分项。”
educational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

educational.sentenceEn: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
educational.translationZh: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了气候变化方面的科学共识，但一些传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师们传播。
educational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

educational.sentenceEn: On top of this, they produce value from their extensive educational programs, their positive impact on the climate through carbon sequestration, their contribution to our cultural and artistic life, and of course through tourism.
educational.translationZh: 除此之外，国家公园还通过广泛的教育项目、碳封存对气候产生的积极影响、对文化艺术生活的贡献，当然还有旅游业，创造着价值。
educational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

educational.sentenceEn: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey.
educational.translationZh: 当最新一批学生正在填写本科申请表并权衡各种选择时，或许值得思考一下：学位的意义、目的和价值究竟发生了怎样的变化？以及Z世代在开启他们教育旅程的第三阶段时需要考虑哪些因素？
educational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

educational.sentenceEn: Surely there must be some middle ground that balances zoos' treatment of animals with their educational potential.
educational.translationZh: 我们肯定能找到某种中间立场，既能平衡动物园对待动物的方式，又能发挥它们的教育潜力。
educational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

easily.sentenceEn: To those of you in the comments section who are having strong feelings about artifacts being removed from cities in the U.S. and Britain and returned to their countries of origin, I would ask you to consider why do you think Americans have more of a right to easily access the Benin Bronzes than the people of Nigeria?
easily.translationZh: 对于评论区中那些对从美国和英国城市移走文物并将其归还给原籍国一事怀有强烈情绪的人，我想请你们思考：为什么你们认为美国人比尼日利亚人更有权利轻松接触到贝宁青铜器？
easily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

easily.sentenceEn: Primary care providers have their hands full and may not be able to follow through with patients who have trouble driving because they can't turn their heads or remember where they are going—or have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach car pedals easily .
easily.translationZh: 初级保健提供者已经忙得不可开交，可能无法跟进那些驾驶有困难的患者——这些患者要么无法转动头部，要么记不住要去哪里，要么因身形变矮而未能充分调整座椅设置，导致无法轻松够到汽车踏板。
easily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

easily.sentenceEn: Water bottles, shopping bags, and other trash litter the planet, from Mount Everest to the Mariana Trench, because plastics are everywhere and don't break down easily .
easily.translationZh: 从珠穆朗玛峰到马里亚纳海沟，水瓶、购物袋和其他垃圾遍布地球，这是因为塑料无处不在且不易分解。
easily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

easily.sentenceEn: They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering.
easily.translationZh: 该研究的合著者、加州大学河滨分校哲学家埃里克·施维茨格贝尔表示，他们选择这一特定行为有三个原因：学生对这一话题的态度多变且不稳定；行为易于测量；伦理学文献普遍认为少吃肉有益，因为这能减少环境危害和动物痛苦。
easily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

easily.sentenceEn: This would be reasonable if it were not for the fact that scientists can easily arrange to cite themselves in their future publications, or get associates to do so for them in return for similar favours.
easily.translationZh: 若不是因为科学家们可以轻易地在自己未来的 publications 中引用自己的研究，或让同事为他们这样做以换取类似的帮助，这种做法本是合理的。
easily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

easily.sentenceEn: They are easily accessible to the general public.
easily.translationZh: 这些唱片价格低廉，随处可得，而且往往比当今的现场演出在艺术质量上高出许多

emerge.sentenceEn: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
emerge.translationZh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

emerge.sentenceEn: Located in the southern Peloponnesian peninsula, Pavlopetri (the modern name of the site) emerged as a Neolithic settlement around 3500 B.C. and became an important trading center for Mycenaean Greece (1650–1180 B.C.).
emerge.translationZh: 帕夫洛佩特里（该遗址的现代名称）位于伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部，约公元前3500年成为新石器时代聚落，并在迈锡尼文明时期（公元前1650-1180年）发展为希腊重要的贸易中心。
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

emerge.sentenceEn: "While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline," says analyst Steve Hawley.
emerge.translationZh: 分析师史蒂夫·霍利表示：“尽管有人乐观地认为，通过采取新的应对措施和最佳实践，盗版活动可能在2027年前后开始趋于稳定，但利益相关者对于盗版何时可能开始减少尚未达成共识。”
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

emerge.sentenceEn: Self-sliding doors began to emerge as a commercial product in 1960 after being invented six years previously by Americans Dee Horton and Lew Hewitt.
emerge.translationZh: 自滑动门由美国人迪·霍顿(Dee Horton)和卢·休伊特(Lew Hewitt)于六年前发明，1960年开始作为商业产品问世。
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

emerge.sentenceEn: Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged : so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.
emerge.translationZh: 最近，这种掠夺性行为又出现了新的表现形式：所谓的支持服务咨询公司，它们为作者个人和期刊提供语言及其他编辑支持，有时会建议投稿人在其文章中添加大量引文。
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

emerge.sentenceEn: A new mode of publication is emerging .
emerge.translationZh: 一种新的出版模式正在兴起。
emerge.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

employer.sentenceEn: Employers are taking note and taking action.
employer.translationZh: 雇主们正对此予以关注并采取行动。
employer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

employer.sentenceEn: Employers need to manage AI tools with the same level of care as any other form of data sharing or storage.
employer.translationZh: 雇主需要像对待任何其他形式的数据共享或存储一样，以同等的谨慎程度来管理人工智能工具。
employer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

employer.sentenceEn: So, to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to the temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
employer.translationZh: 因此，为了在不提高价格的情况下增加员工工资，越来越多的雇主正屈服于小费蔓延和小费膨胀的诱惑。
employer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

employer.sentenceEn: Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, " employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live," Taylor said.
employer.translationZh: 新罕布什尔州南部城镇缺乏足够的经济适用房，"雇主难以吸引员工，而员工也难以找到住处，"泰勒说。
employer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

employer.sentenceEn: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
employer.translationZh: 据估计，由于技术发展的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多元化的渴望，这一代人在其职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事5种不同的职业。
employer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

employer.sentenceEn: Employers need to hire new staff.

enhance.sentenceEn: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.
enhance.translationZh: 教育工作者提倡让高中生完成详尽的实验练习，他们认为此类活动的主要益处在于能够增强学生的逻辑推理和观察能力。
enhance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

enhance.sentenceEn: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.

engage.sentenceEn: But by utilising the natural curiosity of the general public it is possible to overcome many of these challenges by engaging non-scientists directly in the research process.
engage.translationZh: 但通过利用公众的天然好奇心，可以让非科研人员直接参与研究过程，从而克服其中许多挑战。
engage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

engage.sentenceEn: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
engage.translationZh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
engage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

engage.sentenceEn: Engaging in uncommon activities can demonstrate students' determination and dedication.
engage.translationZh: 参与不常见的活动能够展现学生的决心与专注。

estimate.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
estimate.translationZh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失，并导致约25万个就业岗位流失。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

estimate.sentenceEn: It is estimated , for example, that healthcare accounts for only about 20% of health outcomes.
estimate.translationZh: 例如，据估计医疗保健对健康结果的贡献率仅约为20%。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

estimate.sentenceEn: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
estimate.translationZh: 新的人工智能技术集中度尤其高：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占据了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

estimate.sentenceEn: Builders which have costed projects, but have not filed the paperwork, may need to go back and submit fresh estimates , says Marcus Jefford of Build Aviator.
estimate.translationZh: Build Aviator公司的马库斯·杰福德表示，那些已经对项目进行了成本核算但尚未提交文件的建筑商，可能需要重新提交新的预算估算。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

estimate.sentenceEn: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
estimate.translationZh: 据估计，由于技术发展的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多元化的渴望，这一代人在其职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事5种不同的职业。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

estimate.sentenceEn: Builders possibly need to submit new estimates of their projects.
estimate.translationZh: 建筑商可能需要重新提交项目预算。

expand.sentenceEn: Prehistoric humans may have tamed donkeys to help navigate the expanding Sahara.
expand.translationZh: 史前人类可能已经驯化了驴，以帮助他们在不断扩大的撒哈拉沙漠中穿行。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

expand.sentenceEn: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
expand.translationZh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

expand.sentenceEn: These groups of people are part of a rapidly expanding biotechnological social movement of citizen scientists and professional scientists seeking to take discovery out of institutions and put it into the hands of anyone with the enthusiasm.
expand.translationZh: 这些人群是一个迅速发展的生物技术社会运动的组成部分，该运动由公民科学家和专业科学家共同发起，旨在将科学发现从科研机构中解放出来，交到每一个充满热情的人手中。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

expand.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
expand.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

expand.sentenceEn: But in addition to those trusted coworkers, you should expand your horizons and find out about all the people around you.
expand.translationZh: 但除了这些你信任的同事之外，你还应该拓展视野，去了解周围所有的人。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

expand.sentenceEn: expanding vocabulary helps develop reading fluency
expand.translationZh: 扩大词汇量有助于提高阅读流畅度

employ.sentenceEn: The team employed robotics, sonar mapping, and state-of-the-art graphics to survey the site.
employ.translationZh: 该团队采用了机器人技术、声纳测绘和最先进的图形技术对遗址进行了勘测。
employ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

employ.sentenceEn: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
employ.translationZh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
employ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

employ.sentenceEn: If customers are not willing to share data, AI will be starved of essential information and will not be able to function effectively or employ machine learning to improve its marketing content and communication.
employ.translationZh: 如果客户不愿意分享数据，人工智能将缺乏必要的信息，无法有效运作，也无法利用机器学习来改进其营销内容和沟通方式。
employ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

employ.sentenceEn: In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices.
employ.translationZh: 在2019年一项针对53,000个产品页面和11,000个网站的研究中，研究人员发现约有十分之一的网站采用了这些设计手段。
employ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

employ.sentenceEn: Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
employ.translationZh: 更令人惊讶的是，超过一半的“未退休者”——那些计划退休后继续工作或退休后重返职场的人——表示，即使他们有足够的钱安享晚年，也仍会在晚年继续工作。
employ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

evolve.sentenceEn: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
evolve.translationZh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
evolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

evolve.sentenceEn: "For consciousness to evolve , a brain with a threshold level of complexity and capacity is required," he added.
evolve.translationZh: 他补充道：“意识的进化需要一个达到阈值水平的复杂大脑和相应能力。”
evolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

evolve.sentenceEn: Zoos are at the forefront of conservation and constantly evolving to improve how they care for animals and protect each species in its natural habitat.
evolve.translationZh: 动物园处于动物保护的前沿，并且在不断发展进步，以改善其动物照料方式，并保护每个物种在其自然栖息地的生存。
evolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

evolve.sentenceEn: "The concept of retirement is evolving ," said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade.
evolve.translationZh: “退休的概念正在演变，”德美利证券退休业务高级经理克里斯汀·拉塞尔表示。
evolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

evolve.sentenceEn: Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities.
evolve.translationZh: 例如，嫉妒和愤怒可能已经进化为提醒我们注意重要的不平等现象。
evolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

evolve.sentenceEn: It could be that we are evolving two communities of social scientists: one that is discipline-oriented and publishing in highly specialized journals, and one that is problem-oriented and publishing elsewhere, such as policy briefs.
evolve.translationZh: 这可能意味着我们正在形成两类社会科学家群体：一类是以学科为导向，在高度专业化期刊上发表论文；另一类是以问题为导向，在其他渠道发表研究成果，如政策简报等。

expectation.sentenceEn: Different cultures have their norms and expectations regarding dress, which can influence the types of clothing people wear and the meanings attributed to them.
expectation.translationZh: 不同的文化对着装有各自的规范和预期，这会影响人们选择的服装类型及其所代表的含义。
expectation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

expectation.sentenceEn: This increase is sometimes called tipflation—the expectation of ever-higher tip amounts.
expectation.translationZh: 这种增长有时被称为小费膨胀——即期望获得越来越高的小费金额。
expectation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

expectation.sentenceEn: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education.
expectation.translationZh: 事实上，成绩宽恕只是大学回应消费者对高等教育期望的另一种方式。
expectation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

expectation.sentenceEn: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy.
expectation.translationZh: 正是在这样的背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆对英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）旗下的皇家自由医院信托基金作出了严厉的裁决。该信托基金在2015年依据一项模糊的协议向DeepMind移交了160万患者的病历，而该协议对患者权利及隐私期望的考虑严重不足。
expectation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

expectation.sentenceEn: What is most wives' main expectation of their husbands?
expectation.translationZh: 大多数妻子对丈夫的主要期望是什么？

expectation.sentenceEn: It fell short of the latter's expectations .
expectation.translationZh: 这未能满足后者的期望。

expose.sentenceEn: This means that any sensitive business information could potentially be exposed to the world.
expose.translationZh: 这意味着任何敏感的业务信息都可能面临暴露给全世界的风险。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

expose.sentenceEn: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils aged nine and ten—at 45 state primary schools that had not been "previously exposed to RSC pedagogy".
expose.translationZh: 这项随机对照试验涉及45所州立小学的数百名9至10岁五年级学生，这些学校此前"未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团教学法"。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

expose.sentenceEn: Throughout the trip, Jackson juggled multiple cameras and plate sizes using the collodion process that involved coating the plates with a chemical mixture, exposing them and developing the resulting images with a portable darkroom.
expose.translationZh: 在整个旅程中，杰克逊使用火棉胶湿版法操作着多台相机和不同尺寸的感光板——这一工艺需要在感光板上涂抹化学混合液，进行曝光，然后用便携式暗房冲洗成像。

expose.sentenceEn: In a series of four experiments, behavioral scientists at the University of Chicago and the Wisconsin School of Business tested students' willingness to expose themselves to unpleasant stimuli in an effort to satisfy curiosity.
expose.translationZh: 在一系列四项实验中，芝加哥大学和威斯康星商学院的行为科学家测试了学生为满足好奇心而愿意让自己接触不愉快刺激的程度。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

expose.sentenceEn: In a recent study involving over 400 healthy adults, researchers from Carnegie Mellon University in Pennsylvania examined the effects of perceived social support and the receipt of hugs on the participants' susceptibility to developing the common cold after being exposed to the virus.
expose.translationZh: 在最近一项涉及400多名健康成年人的研究中，来自宾夕法尼亚州卡内基梅隆大学的研究人员考察了感知到的社会支持和获得拥抱对参与者在接触病毒后感染普通感冒的易感性的影响。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

expose.sentenceEn: Mr. Dunwell has begun bringing high school juniors to the factory so they can get exposed to its culture.
expose.translationZh: 邓威尔先生已经开始邀请高中生三年级学生来工厂参观，让他们接触工厂文化。
expose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

extra.sentenceEn: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
extra.translationZh: 这已经成了一个令人沮丧却又如期而至的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择、只能依靠铁路通勤上班或出行的人们带来沉重的额外负担。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

extra.sentenceEn: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
extra.translationZh: 在线教育可以降低额外培训和教学的成本，使其更加经济实惠。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

extra.sentenceEn: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
extra.translationZh: 例如，在波士顿学院，如果你从其他院系转学到护理学院，就必须额外多读一年。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

extra.sentenceEn: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
extra.translationZh: 《科学》杂志主编马西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该期刊将在其同行评审流程中新增一轮统计数据核查。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

extra.sentenceEn: Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.
extra.translationZh: 不需要额外培训的学生可以将他们的债务大山减少三分之一。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

extra.translationZh: 零排放模型需要额外资金支持。

editor.sentenceEn: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals.
editor.translationZh: 奇怪的是，编辑理应效力的期刊根本没有从中获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用。
editor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

editor.sentenceEn: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor , a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.
editor.translationZh: 对于希望避开引用操纵集团活动的作者而言：当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求您添加不恰当的参考文献时，请勿照办，并务必向期刊报告这一请求。
editor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

editor.sentenceEn: In one example, an individual—acting as author, editor , and consultant—was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.
editor.translationZh: 举个例子，有个人身兼作者、编辑和顾问三职，竟然能利用至少15家期刊为三所大学的五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。
editor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

editor.sentenceEn: "This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
editor.translationZh: 巴纳集团总编辑罗克珊·斯通表示：“这表明，在应对这一问题上，个人确实负有重大责任。”
editor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

editor.sentenceEn: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process".
editor.translationZh: 他在2012年撰文指出，研究人员应提高自身标准，而期刊也应采取更严格的措施，“聘请具备统计素养的评审人员和能够验证这一过程的编辑”。
editor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

editor.sentenceEn: Data Analysis Finds Its Way onto Editors ' Desks
editor.translationZh: 数据分析走进编辑案头

ethics.sentenceEn: As a result, they are raising tricky questions about ethics and copyright.
ethics.translationZh: 因此，这些程序引发了关于伦理和版权的棘手问题。
ethics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

ethics.sentenceEn: Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion.
ethics.translationZh: 在四个大型哲学班中，一半的学生阅读了一篇关于工厂化养殖肉类伦理问题的文章，还可以选择观看一个11分钟的相关主题视频，并参与了50分钟的讨论。
ethics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

ethics.sentenceEn: But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects.
ethics.translationZh: 但发表在《认知》期刊上的一项新研究发现，在至少一种现实情境中，单节伦理课可能产生了持久影响。
ethics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

ethics.sentenceEn: Although ethics classes are common around the world, scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior; evidence either way is weak, relying on contrived laboratory tests or sometimes unreliable self-reports.
ethics.translationZh: 尽管道德伦理课在全球范围内十分普遍，但科学家们不确定这些课程是否真能改变行为；无论支持还是反对的证据都很薄弱，要么依赖人为设计的实验室测试，要么有时依赖不可靠的自我报告。
ethics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ethics.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books.
ethics.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔曾预测这种干预不会产生任何效果；他此前发现，伦理学教授在一系列行为上与其他教授并无不同，包括投票率、献血行为和归还图书馆书籍的情况。
ethics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

ethics.sentenceEn: It is a hot topic in ethics classes.
ethics.translationZh: 这是伦理学课程中的一个热门话题。

efficient.sentenceEn: According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
efficient.translationZh: 西谢尔指出，尽管钉子价格下降部分源于铁价和能源成本的降低，但大部分功劳应归于钉子制造商——他们找到了将钢材转化为钉子的更高效方法。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

efficient.sentenceEn: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient .
efficient.translationZh: 当我们的大脑在专注和不专注于某项任务之间切换时，往往会变得更加高效。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

efficient.sentenceEn: In fact, "becoming more efficient " is part of the problem.
efficient.translationZh: 事实上，“提高效率”本身就是问题的一部分。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

efficient.sentenceEn: Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient .
efficient.translationZh: 深度阅读不仅需要时间，还需要一种特殊的时间，这种时间无法仅通过提高效率来获得。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

efficient.sentenceEn: Although electronic means of payment may be more efficient than a payments system based on paper, several factors work against the disappearance of the paper system.
efficient.translationZh: 尽管电子支付方式可能比纸质支付系统更高效，但有几个因素阻碍着纸质支付系统的消失。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

efficient.sentenceEn: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
efficient.translationZh: 其目的是促使社会科学家将其研究工作与其他领域相结合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源以及包容、创新和安全的社会。

electronic.sentenceEn: The advent of electronic publishing and authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.
electronic.translationZh: 电子出版的出现以及作者为其论文寻找发表渠道的需求，催生了数千种新期刊。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

electronic.sentenceEn: Your home colleagues – your family – have no clear rewards for their labor; they need to be talked into it, or if they're teenagers, threatened with complete removal of all electronic devices.
electronic.translationZh: 你家里的"同事"——也就是你的家人——付出劳动却没有明确的回报；你得好说歹说才能让他们干活，要是碰上青少年，还得威胁他们要没收所有电子设备才行。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

electronic.sentenceEn: Because electronic payments are immediate, they eliminate the float for the consumer.
electronic.translationZh: 由于电子支付是即时到账的，这就消除了消费者的'浮动期'。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

electronic.sentenceEn: Fourth, electronic means of payment may raise security and privacy concerns.
electronic.translationZh: 第四，电子支付方式可能会引发安全和隐私方面的担忧。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

electronic.sentenceEn: The fact that this is not an uncommon occurrence means that dishonest persons might be able to access bank accounts in electronic payments systems and steal from someone else's accounts.
electronic.translationZh: 这种情况并不罕见，这意味着不诚实的人可能会入侵电子支付系统中的银行账户，盗取他人账户资金。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

electronic.sentenceEn: First, it is very expensive to set up the computer, card reader, and telecommunications networks necessary to make electronic money the dominant form of payment.
electronic.translationZh: 首先，建立使电子货币成为主要支付方式所必需的计算机、读卡器和电信网络成本高昂。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

elite.sentenceEn: Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities.
elite.translationZh: 相反，科伊尔指出，由于人们认为科技带来的好处都流向了少数繁华城市的精英阶层，许多人心中的不满正在悄然升温。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

elite.sentenceEn: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
elite.translationZh: 为了确保精英女性获得更多此类机会，他们提议实施政府配额制度。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

elite.sentenceEn: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
elite.translationZh: 艾丽斯·李在《新共和》杂志中指出，在没有扩大合格女性人才库的情况下增加董事会席位机会，已经导致了一种"金裙现象"——即同一位精英女性在多家不同的董事会中占据多个席位。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

elite.sentenceEn: The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes.
elite.translationZh: 相比之下，奥运会的申办者则希望让更多人参与体育运动，并培养更多精英运动员。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

elite.sentenceEn: The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
elite.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特的研究表明，并非所有在经济衰退期毕业的人都会发现自己的人生机遇变得黯淡：那些拥有精英大学学位的毕业生能相当迅速地追赶上如果他们在经济状况较好时期毕业本该拥有的地位；而被甩在后面的是那些学历不如他们的普通大众。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

elite.sentenceEn: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
elite.translationZh: 尽管美国最高法院早在1880年Strauder诉西弗吉尼亚州一案中就禁止了陪审团遴选过程中蓄意的种族歧视，但挑选所谓精英陪审团或蓝带陪审团的做法却为规避这一规定及其他反歧视法律提供了便利途径。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

elsewhere.sentenceEn: They serve no purpose in a museum in the United States or elsewhere except as curious objects.
elsewhere.translationZh: 这些文物若留在美国或其他地方的博物馆，除了作为猎奇之物外，毫无意义。
elsewhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

elsewhere.sentenceEn: Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere .
elsewhere.translationZh: 在表现最差的10个州中，不乏一些人口最多的州，其中包括得克萨斯州——该州被评为最低等级（F级），但其影响力却不成比例地大，因为该州的教科书在其他地区也有广泛销售。
elsewhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

elsewhere.sentenceEn: Whether this research translates elsewhere is anybody's guess.
elsewhere.translationZh: 这项研究的结论能否适用于其他地区，目前尚无定论。
elsewhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

elsewhere.sentenceEn: Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
elsewhere.translationZh: 到19世纪90年代，抓拍自然流露的笑容已相对容易，因此我们必须从其他方面来解释为什么维多利亚时代的人们仍然不愿在拍照时微笑。
elsewhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

elsewhere.sentenceEn: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.
elsewhere.translationZh: 加拿大及其他地区在这方面的努力往好了说也只能算是迟缓乏力，这就造成了一种局面：我们常常听到雇主四处招不到工人，即便在失业率居高不下的时期和地区也是如此。
elsewhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

elsewhere.sentenceEn: It could be that we are evolving two communities of social scientists: one that is discipline-oriented and publishing in highly specialized journals, and one that is problem-oriented and publishing elsewhere , such as policy briefs.
elsewhere.translationZh: 这可能意味着我们正在形成两类社会科学家群体：一类是以学科为导向，在高度专业化期刊上发表论文；另一类是以问题为导向，在其他渠道发表研究成果，如政策简报等。

enable.sentenceEn: For instance, as convenient and provocative, AI enables virtual try-on experiences where you can virtually test makeup, hairstyles, clothing, and even cosmetic procedures before making any physical changes.
enable.translationZh: 例如，人工智能提供了既便捷又具启发性的体验，让你在进行任何实际改变之前，能够虚拟尝试化妆、发型、服装，甚至美容整形手术。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

enable.sentenceEn: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
enable.translationZh: 该审查报告建议发起一项全国性的品牌宣传活动，以增强图书馆的实体感；重新推行一项让会员持卡即可使用全国任一图书馆的计划；以及为儿童自动办理入会手续。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

enable.sentenceEn: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
enable.translationZh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

enable.sentenceEn: Their well-developed hippocampal structures may enable elephants, like rats and people, to construct cognitive maps.
enable.translationZh: 它们发达的海马体结构或许能让大象像老鼠和人类一样构建认知地图。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

enable.sentenceEn: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
enable.translationZh: 荷兰出版巨头爱思唯尔(Elsevier)声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年利润超过9亿英镑；而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，以使研究人员能够获取他们自己的公共资助研究成果。尽管人们愈发迫切地试图改变这种局面，但这两个数字似乎都在持续上涨，势不可挡。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

enable.sentenceEn: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
enable.translationZh: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村协调性，同时又能维持低密度的城市生活。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

enforcement.sentenceEn: In 2017 the association formed the Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE), an enforcement task force of about 100 detectives circling the globe to help local authorities arrest streaming pirates.
enforcement.translationZh: 2017年，该协会成立了创意与娱乐联盟(ACE)，这是一个由约100名侦探组成的全球执法特遣队，旨在协助地方当局逮捕流媒体盗版者。
enforcement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

enforcement.sentenceEn: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm.
enforcement.translationZh: 《联邦贸易委员会法案》第5条授权联邦贸易委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着只有当某公司的隐私做法具有误导性或对消费者造成不正当损害时，联邦贸易委员会才能在事后采取行动。
enforcement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

enforcement.sentenceEn: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible demise.
enforcement.translationZh: 七个月后，经过一场选举，新当选的保守派市议会暂停了清洁空气区的执行，这是该区域可能走向终结的第一步。
enforcement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

enforcement.sentenceEn: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement .
enforcement.translationZh: 在丹麦、美国和其他一些国家，时尚行业正尝试为模特和时尚形象制定自愿性标准，这些标准的执行更多依赖同行压力。
enforcement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

enforcement.sentenceEn: The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen Fashion Week (CFW), which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute.
enforcement.translationZh: 该宪章的主要执行手段是拒绝设计师和模特经纪公司参加哥本哈根时装周（CFW）——该时装周由丹麦时装协会举办。
enforcement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

entirely.sentenceEn: While veterans of previous expeditions had written at length about stunning sights, these vivid photographs were another thing entirely .
entirely.translationZh: 虽然先前探险队的老兵们曾详细描述过那些令人惊叹的景观，但这些生动的照片却完全是另一回事。

entirely.sentenceEn: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
entirely.translationZh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对向法国消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收全新税费。
entirely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

entirely.sentenceEn: To be fair, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods entirely , but to reduce their lifetime intake.
entirely.translationZh: 平心而论，英国食品标准局并非要求人们完全不吃烤肉，而是建议减少一生中的摄入量。
entirely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

entirely.sentenceEn: But, the wonderful thing about failure is that it's entirely up to us to decide how to look at it.
entirely.translationZh: 但是，失败的美妙之处在于，如何看待它完全取决于我们自己。
entirely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

entirely.translationZh: 但也不能完全排除这种可能性。
entirely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

entirely.sentenceEn: The trend toward "less" was not entirely foreign.
entirely.translationZh: 这种追求“简约”的趋势并非完全源自国外。
entirely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

exactly.sentenceEn: We usually only get the human's side of history through written accounts, but of course written history does not always record exactly how something happened.
exactly.translationZh: 通常我们只能通过文字记载了解人类视角下的历史，但显然，文字记载的历史并不总能准确还原事情发生的真相。
exactly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

exactly.sentenceEn: When finding their way to waterholes, they headed off in exactly the right direction, on one occasion from a distance of roughly thirty miles.
exactly.translationZh: 在寻找水源地时，它们总能准确地朝着正确方向出发，有一次甚至是从约30英里外的地方直接前往。
exactly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

exactly.sentenceEn: Shoppers also benefit from seeing exactly where—and to whom—their money is going.
exactly.translationZh: 购物者也能清楚地知道自己的钱流向了哪里、给了谁，这也是一大好处。
exactly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

exactly.sentenceEn: And if you do, what exactly should you say?
exactly.translationZh: 而如果你决定开口，具体应该怎么说呢？
exactly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

exactly.sentenceEn: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
exactly.translationZh: 挪威在全国范围内实行企业性别配额制度后，就恰好发生了这种情况。
exactly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

exactly.sentenceEn: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of "Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus," by Mary Shelley.
exactly.translationZh: 今年是玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦；或现代普罗米修斯》出版整整两个世纪。
exactly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

exchange.sentenceEn: As a result, these structures became important centres for cultural exchange and interaction, with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs, as well as taking knowledge with them, greatly influencing the development of several civilisations.
exchange.translationZh: 因此，这些建筑成为了文化交流与互动的重要中心。旅行者们在此分享各自的文化、思想和信仰，同时也带走知识，这对多个文明的发展产生了深远影响。
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

exchange.sentenceEn: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
exchange.translationZh: 在某些方面，科学出版模式与社交互联网经济颇为相似：人们免费提供劳动，以换取获得地位的希望，而少数运营着市场平台的大公司却赚取了巨额利润。
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

exchange.sentenceEn: "There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing," said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week.
exchange.translationZh: 美国证券交易委员会委员丹尼尔·加拉格尔在本周的一次演讲中表示：“以牺牲长期投资为代价的短期思维似乎占据了主导地位。”
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

exchange.sentenceEn: If we readjust our view of arguments – from a verbal fight or tennis game to a reasoned exchange through which we all gain mutual respect, and understanding – then we change the very nature of what it means to "win" an argument.
exchange.translationZh: 如果我们重新调整对争论的看法——从一场言语争斗或网球比赛转变为一种理性交流，通过这种交流我们都能获得相互尊重和理解——那么我们就改变了“赢得”一场争论的本质意义。

exchange.sentenceEn: However, Obamacare has allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance through Medicaid or the exchanges .
exchange.translationZh: 然而，奥巴马医改已使超过1200万人能够通过医疗补助计划或医保交易所获得保险。
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

exchange.sentenceEn: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange .
exchange.translationZh: 一年后，她才成为一家小型互联网大宗商品交易所的负责人。
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: Joseph Adegboyega-Edun, a Maryland high school guidance counselor, says unconventional extracurricular activities can help students impress college admissions offices, assuming they demonstrated serious commitment.
extracurricular.translationZh: 马里兰州高中辅导员约瑟夫·阿德博耶加-埃敦表示，只要学生表现出认真投入的态度，非传统的课外活动就能帮助他们给大学招生办公室留下深刻印象。
extracurricular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: High school students who have had a strong positive influence on their community through an extracurricular activity may impress a college and win a scholarship, says Erica Gwyn, a former math and science magnet program assistant at a public high school who is now executive director of the Kaleidoscope Careers Academy in Atlanta, a nonprofit organization.
extracurricular.translationZh: 亚特兰大非营利组织万花筒职业学院执行主任埃丽卡·格温表示，通过课外活动对社区产生重大积极影响的高中生可能会给大学留下深刻印象并获得奖学金。她曾是一所公立高中的数学和科学磁铁项目助理。
extracurricular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: High school students eager to stand out in the college application process often participate in a litany of extracurricular activities hoping to bolster their chances of admission to a selective undergraduate institution.
extracurricular.translationZh: 渴望在大学申请过程中脱颖而出的高中生，往往会参加一系列课外活动，希望以此提高被名牌本科院校录取的几率。
extracurricular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: "No college will expect that a student has a huge laundry list of extracurriculars that they have been passionately involved in each for an extended period of time," Rexford wrote in an email.
extracurricular.translationZh: 雷克斯福德在邮件中写道：“没有哪所大学会期望学生列出一长串课外活动，并且每项活动都能长期投入热情参与。”
extracurricular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in.
extracurricular.translationZh: 然而，大学招生专家表示，准大学生课外活动的质量比其参与的活动数量更为重要。
extracurricular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: It is advisable for students to choose an extracurricular activity that is related to their future study at college.
extracurricular.translationZh: 学生最好选择与他们未来大学学习相关的课外活动。

economist.sentenceEn: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
economist.translationZh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
economist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

economist.sentenceEn: I am an economist , after all.
economist.translationZh: 毕竟，我是一名经济学家。
economist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

economist.sentenceEn: The price of nails fell by 90% between the late 1700s and mid-1900s, as economist Daniel Sichel points out in a research paper.
economist.translationZh: 经济学家丹尼尔·西谢尔在一篇研究论文中指出，18世纪末至20世纪中期，钉子的价格下降了90%。
economist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

economist.sentenceEn: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress.
economist.translationZh: 剑桥大学经济学家黛安娜·科伊尔在其新书《齿轮与怪兽：经济学是什么，应该是什么》中指出，数字经济需要我们以新的方式思考进步。
economist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

economist.sentenceEn: In fact, poverty alleviation and environmental protection are often viewed as conflicting goals, says Paul Ferraro, an economist at Johns Hopkins University.
economist.translationZh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学的经济学家保罗·费拉罗表示，事实上，减贫与环境保护往往被视为相互冲突的目标。
economist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

economist.sentenceEn: "Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist , Andrew Haldane.
economist.translationZh: 英国央行首席经济学家安德鲁·霍尔丹表示，上市公司中的“短期主义”——即追求快速获利的欲望——愈演愈烈。
economist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

estate.sentenceEn: The other issue is that many children – especially older ones – may base their real estate knowledge on HGTV shows, said Aaron Norris of The Norris Group in Riverside, Calif.
estate.translationZh: 加利福尼亚州里弗赛德市诺里斯集团的亚伦·诺里斯表示，另一个问题是许多孩子——尤其是年龄较大的孩子——他们的房地产知识可能来源于HGTV的电视节目。
estate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

estate.sentenceEn: "Speaking with your children before you make a real estate decision is wise, but I wouldn't base the purchasing decision solely on their opinions." Hampson said.
estate.translationZh: 汉普森说：“在做出房产决策前与孩子沟通是明智之举，但我不会将购房决定完全建立在他们的意见之上。”
estate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

estate.sentenceEn: Parents need to remind their children that their needs and desires may change over time, said Julie Gurner, a real estate analyst with FitSmallBusiness.com.
estate.translationZh: FitSmallBusiness.com的房地产分析师朱莉·古纳表示，父母需要提醒孩子，他们的需求和愿望可能会随着时间的推移而改变。
estate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

estate.sentenceEn: Greg Jaroszewski, real estate broker with Gagliardo Realty Associates, said he's not convinced that kids should be involved in selecting a home – but their opinions should be considered in regards to proximity to friends and social activities, if possible.
estate.translationZh: Gagliardo Realty Associates房地产经纪人格雷格·雅罗谢夫斯基表示，他并不认为孩子们应该参与选择住房——但如果可能的话，在考虑与朋友的居住距离以及社交活动便利性方面，应该听取他们的意见。
estate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

estate.sentenceEn: Younger children should feel like they're choosing their home – without actually getting a choice in the matter, said Adam Bailey, real estate attorney based in New York.
estate.translationZh: 纽约房地产律师亚当·贝利表示，年幼的孩子应该感觉像是自己在选择家——但实际上并不让他们真正做决定。
estate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

estate.sentenceEn: McClain's little ones aren't the only kids who have an opinion when it comes to housing, and in many cases youngsters' views weigh heavily on parents' real estate decisions, according to a 2018 Harris Poll survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults.
estate.translationZh: 哈里斯民意调查公司2018年对2000多名美国成年人进行的一项调查显示，在住房问题上，麦克莱恩的孩子们并非唯一有自己想法的孩子，而且在很多情况下，年轻人的意见对父母的房产决策影响很大。
estate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: While AI offers exciting possibilities, it also raises ethical concerns.
ethical.translationZh: 人工智能在带来令人兴奋的可能性的同时，也引发了伦理方面的担忧。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
ethical.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: Where is the line between ethical , persuasive design and dark patterns?
ethical.translationZh: 那么，符合伦理的劝导式设计与暗黑模式之间的界限究竟在哪里？
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
ethical.translationZh: 新加坡某机构首席执行官陈杰豪指出，只要决策是基于海量数据做出的，“你很快就会陷入诸多伦理问题之中”。该机构正协助政府制定人工智能伦理使用自愿准则。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand.
ethical.translationZh: 但这并不意味着人工智能相关的关键伦理问题尚未到来。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
ethical.translationZh: 甚至在电灯泡发明之前，这位作者就创作了一部杰出的科幻小说，预示了未来科技将会引发的诸多伦理问题。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

explanation.sentenceEn: It can be hard for scientists to make the case because our work is complex, often takes place behind closed doors and does not always lend itself to easy interpretation or explanation .
explanation.translationZh: 科学家们往往难以阐明自己的工作价值，因为我们的研究复杂难懂，常常在闭门情况下进行，而且并非总能轻易解释或说明。
explanation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

explanation.sentenceEn: The likely explanation is that the withdrawal was rushed, and they didn't want the local Caledonians getting their hands on 10 tons of weapon-grade iron.
explanation.translationZh: 最可能的解释是，罗马军队撤退仓促，不愿让当地的喀里多尼亚人得到这10吨可用于制造武器的铁。
explanation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

explanation.sentenceEn: Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
explanation.translationZh: 到19世纪90年代，抓拍自然流露的笑容已相对容易，因此我们必须从其他方面来解释为什么维多利亚时代的人们仍然不愿在拍照时微笑。
explanation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

explanation.sentenceEn: One explanation might be the loss of dignity displayed through a cheesy grin.
explanation.translationZh: 一种解释可能是，廉价俗气的笑容会显得有失体面。
explanation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

explanation.sentenceEn: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore.
explanation.translationZh: 尽管教会试图压制新一代的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙运行规律的解释却以前所未有的速度涌现，人们再也无法视而不见。
explanation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

explanation.sentenceEn: Also, some research suggests that the explanation for rising rates of mortality, mental-health problems, and addiction among poorly-educated, middle-aged people is a shortage of well-paid jobs.
explanation.translationZh: 此外，一些研究表明，教育水平较低的中年人群死亡率、心理健康问题和成瘾率上升的原因在于高薪工作的短缺。
explanation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

emphasis.sentenceEn: As the streamers' emphasis changed from subscriber growth to profitability, prices for the services went up and the number of new shows went down to 481 released in 2023, with the number expected to dip into the 300s within a few years.
emphasis.translationZh: 随着流媒体平台的工作重心从用户增长转向盈利，各项服务价格随之上涨，而新剧集的数量在2023年降至481部，预计未来几年内这一数字还将跌破400部。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

emphasis.sentenceEn: Perhaps, she suggests, the trend will change our approach to learning from a focus on individual facts and memorization to an emphasis on more conceptual thinking—something that is not available on the Internet.
emphasis.translationZh: 她认为，这种趋势或许会改变我们的学习方式——从专注于单个事实和死记硬背，转向更注重概念性思考，而这正是互联网无法提供的。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

emphasis.sentenceEn: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.
emphasis.translationZh: 而过分强调他们的意见可能会毁掉一笔极好的购房交易。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

emphasis.sentenceEn: The current emphasis on standardized testing highlights analysis and procedure, meaning that few of us inherently use our innovative and collaborative modes of thought.
emphasis.translationZh: 当前对标准化测试的重视，突出了分析和程序化思维，这意味着我们中很少有人会本能地运用创新和协作的思维模式。
emphasis.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

emphasis.sentenceEn: The emphasis on data gathered first-hand, combined with a cross-cultural perspective brought to the analysis of cultures past and present, makes this study a unique and distinctly important social science.
emphasis.translationZh: 强调收集第一手资料，并结合跨文化视角分析古今文化，这使得人类学成为一门独特且极为重要的社会科学。
emphasis.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

emphasis.sentenceEn: Excessive emphasis has been placed on the basics.
emphasis.translationZh: 人们过分强调基础知识。
emphasis.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

entire.sentenceEn: To prevent entire ecosystems from going up in smoke, Martin said, people must bring healthy fire back to places that need it.
entire.translationZh: 马丁表示，为了防止整个生态系统毁于一旦，人们必须将“健康的火种”带回那些真正需要它的地方。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

entire.sentenceEn: If there's congestion or, for example, a local train breaks down, the entire high-speed network is affected.
entire.translationZh: 如果发生拥堵，或者例如有一辆区间列车发生故障，整个高铁网络都会受到影响。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

entire.sentenceEn: The idea that one might burn down an entire house just to reclaim the nails underlines how scarce, costly and valuable the simple-seeming technology was.
entire.translationZh: 为收回钉子而不惜烧毁整栋房屋的想法，凸显了这项看似简单的技术在当时是多么稀缺、昂贵且珍贵。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

entire.sentenceEn: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
entire.translationZh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

entire.sentenceEn: In another case, American archaeologists René Million and George Cowgill spent years systematically mapping the entire city of Teotihuacán in the Valley of Mexico near what is now Mexico City.
entire.translationZh: 在另一个案例中，美国考古学家勒内·米利翁和乔治·考吉尔花费数年时间，对墨西哥谷特奥蒂瓦坎古城进行了系统性的全面测绘。这座古城位于如今墨西哥城附近。

entire.sentenceEn: He was not interested in daily politics, but concerned with questions of moral behavior and the larger questions of right and wrong affecting the entire society.
entire.translationZh: 他对日常政治不感兴趣，而是关注道德行为问题以及影响整个社会的更大层面的是非问题。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

epidemic.sentenceEn: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
epidemic.translationZh: 如今，乌托邦式的理想已不再流行，因为我们对面临的各种威胁有了更深刻的认识，从小行星撞击到流感大流行，再到气候变化。
epidemic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

epidemic.sentenceEn: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
epidemic.translationZh: 然而，要形成一个社会流行潮，每个受到影响的人都必须接着去影响自己的熟人，而这些熟人又必须转而影响他们自己的熟人，依此类推；而有多少人会关注这些传播链中的每个人，与最初的影响者几乎没有关系。
epidemic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

epidemic.sentenceEn: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.
epidemic.translationZh: 然而，一些研究人员在近期的研究中发现，有影响力人士对社会流行现象的影响远不如人们普遍认为的那么大。
