epidemic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

epidemic.sentenceEn: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics " are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected.
epidemic.translationZh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在其著作《引爆点》中提出，“社会流行潮”在很大程度上是由极少数特殊个体的行为所推动的。这些人通常被称为“影响者”，他们要么消息异常灵通，要么极具说服力，要么拥有广泛的人脉。
epidemic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

epidemic.sentenceEn: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics , by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.
epidemic.translationZh: 然而，根据两级传播理论，恰恰是这些非名人影响者应该通过直接影响他们的朋友和同事来推动社会流行潮。
epidemic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

epidemic.sentenceEn: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
epidemic.translationZh: 鉴于目前近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——可以说这是一场由沟通失败引发的流行病。
epidemic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

era.sentenceEn: In the information era , large data sets, small teams and financial restrictions have slowed scientific process.
era.translationZh: 在信息时代，庞大的数据集、小型团队和资金限制减缓了科学进程。
era.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

era.sentenceEn: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era —the Age of Reason.
era.translationZh: 当许多人开始肩负起将理性思考与科学哲学融入世界的使命时，文艺复兴时代宣告结束，一个全新的时代——理性时代，已然到来。
era.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

era.sentenceEn: Grade inflation – the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades – is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased.
era.translationZh: 成绩膨胀——即过去几十年来平均绩点（GPA）的逐渐上升——通常被认为是高等教育进入消费时代的产物。在这个时代，学生被当作需要取悦的顾客来对待。
era.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

era.sentenceEn: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
era.translationZh: 在过去技术发生剧烈变革的时代，企业家们通过想出将劳动力与机器结合的方法，推动了这一转型过程。
era.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

era.sentenceEn: The difference between today's workplace and the "dress for success" era is that the range of options is so much broader.
era.translationZh: 如今的职场与“为成功而着装”时代的不同之处在于，着装选择的范围要广泛得多。
era.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

era.sentenceEn: It led to a new era of isolating culture.
era.translationZh: 它开启了一个孤立文化的新时代。

escape.sentenceEn: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature.
escape.translationZh: 国家公园为美国民众提供了巨大价值，既是休闲避难之所，也是自然的象征。
escape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

escape.sentenceEn: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape .
escape.translationZh: 在实验过程中，社交型机器鼠会跟随活鼠四处活动，玩同样的玩具，并会打开笼门让被困的老鼠逃脱。
escape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

escape.sentenceEn: We aim to be objective, but we cannot escape the context of our unique life experiences.
escape.translationZh: 我们力求客观，但无法摆脱自身独特生活经历所形成的背景。
escape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

escape.sentenceEn: In fact, circumstances seem to be designed to bring out the best in us, and if we feel that we have been "wronged" then we are unlikely to begin a conscious effort to escape from our situation.
escape.translationZh: 事实上，环境仿佛是为激发我们最好的一面而设计的，如果我们觉得自己“受了委屈”，就不太可能有意识地努力去摆脱现状。
escape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

escape.sentenceEn: Thus poor countries might not be able to escape their poverty traps without political changes that may be possible only with broader formal education.
escape.translationZh: 因此，贫穷国家若不进行政治变革，或许就无法摆脱其贫困陷阱，而政治变革的实现可能只有通过更广泛的正规教育。
escape.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
escape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

escape.sentenceEn: He adds humbly that perhaps he was "superior to the common run of men in noticing things which easily escape attention, and in observing them carefully."
escape.translationZh: 他谦逊地补充道，或许他“在注意到那些容易被忽略的事物，并对其进行仔细观察方面，比普通人略胜一筹。”
escape.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
escape.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

ease.sentenceEn: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
ease.translationZh: 通常情况下，阐明这一原则并不能简化界定界限的挑战。
ease.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ease.sentenceEn: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease .
ease.translationZh: 无论是否获得许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、司法管辖区域和身份的界限。
ease.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

effectively.sentenceEn: Science education today revolves around the idea of scientific literacy — the base-level knowledge about science that nonscientists require to effectively get on in the world.
effectively.translationZh: 当今的科学教育围绕着“科学素养”这一理念展开，即非科学家群体为了在现实世界中有效生活所必须具备的基础科学知识。
effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

effectively.sentenceEn: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively .
effectively.translationZh: 这些由集体“违规”踏出的路径，常常在整齐的绿地中形成一条条被踩出的泥土小径，它们抄近道、横穿草坪、翻越山丘，展现了人类（和动物）以最有效方式从A点到达B点的本能倾向。
effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

effectively.sentenceEn: If customers are not willing to share data, AI will be starved of essential information and will not be able to function effectively or employ machine learning to improve its marketing content and communication.
effectively.translationZh: 如果客户不愿意分享数据，人工智能将缺乏必要的信息，无法有效运作，也无法利用机器学习来改进其营销内容和沟通方式。
effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

effectively.sentenceEn: "Since plants don't have nervous systems, the chances that they have consciousness are effectively zero."
effectively.translationZh: “由于植物没有神经系统，它们拥有意识的可能性实际上为零。”
effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

effectively.sentenceEn: Instead, they look after their wellbeing instinctively, and usually more effectively than we do as grownups.
effectively.translationZh: 相反，他们本能地照顾自己的幸福感，而且通常比我们成年人做得更有效。
effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

effectively.sentenceEn: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
effectively.translationZh: 为鼓励创新与竞争，该报告呼吁加大研究投入，精心设计连贯的课程体系以提升学生在21世纪解决问题和有效沟通的能力，增加教师经费投入，并鼓励学者将所学知识应用于应对当今重大挑战。
effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

element.sentenceEn: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
element.translationZh: 其他科学家也免费从事专业的同行评审工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心要素。
element.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

element.sentenceEn: The efforts of America's highest-earning 1% have been one of the more dynamic elements of the global economy.
element.translationZh: 美国收入最高的1%人群所付出的努力，一直是全球经济中更具活力的要素之一。
element.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

element.sentenceEn: While climate is a key element , Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
element.translationZh: 莫里茨表示，尽管气候是一个关键因素，但也不应因此忽视其他相关因素。
element.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

element.sentenceEn: On display here are various fantasy elements whose reference, at some basic level, seems to be the natural world.
element.translationZh: 在这里呈现的是各种奇幻元素，这些元素在某种基本层面上似乎都指向着自然界。
element.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

element.sentenceEn: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
element.translationZh: 社会影响动态中的基本要素是什么？

element.sentenceEn: Soil is an important element to be taken into account in forest restoration.
element.translationZh: 土壤是森林恢复过程中需要考虑的重要因素。

enormous.sentenceEn: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
enormous.translationZh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

enormous.sentenceEn: And so we would call on state lawmakers from Richmond to Albany to consider reviewing their own wetlands protections and see for themselves the enormous stakes involved.
enormous.translationZh: 因此，我们呼吁从里士满到奥尔巴尼的各州立法者考虑审查各自的湿地保护措施，并亲自了解其中涉及的重大利害关系。
enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

enormous.sentenceEn: Pennsylvania farmers, to use one telling example, aren't thinking about next year's blue crab harvest in Maryland when they decide whether to spread animal waste on their fields, yet the runoff into nearby creeks can have enormous impact downstream.
enormous.translationZh: 举一个典型的例子，宾夕法尼亚州的农民在决定是否在田地里撒动物粪便时，不会考虑到马里兰州来年的蓝蟹收成，然而流入附近小溪的径流却可能对下游产生巨大影响。
enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

enormous.sentenceEn: Yet this enormous resource is not contributing enough to today's global challenges, including climate change, security, sustainable development and health.
enormous.translationZh: 然而，这一庞大资源对当今全球挑战的贡献却不足，这些挑战包括气候变化、安全、可持续发展和健康问题。
enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

enormous.sentenceEn: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
enormous.translationZh: 毫无疑问，同伴群体对我们的行为有着巨大影响。
enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

enormous.sentenceEn: But by the end of 2009 Ms. Simmons was under fire for having sat on Goldman's compensation committee; how could she have let those enormous bonus payouts pass unremarked?
enormous.translationZh: 但到2009年底，西蒙斯女士因在高盛薪酬委员会任职而受到抨击：她怎么能让那些巨额奖金支出毫无异议地获得通过呢？
enormous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

equal.sentenceEn: Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.
equal.translationZh: 在表达完你的观点（是作为一种立场，而非事实）之后，要对他人的看法表现出同样的好奇心。
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第4句

equal.sentenceEn: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of " equal protection".
equal.translationZh: 由于加州这项法律适用于所有董事会，甚至包括那些从未有过歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的“平等保护”原则。
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

equal.sentenceEn: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society – that all are equal in treatment by government – is undermined.
equal.translationZh: 如果人脉关系可以买卖，那么民主社会的一个基本前提——即所有人在政府面前都应得到平等对待——就会受到损害。
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

equal.sentenceEn: The idea that "housing crisis" equals "concreted meadows" is pure lobby talk.
equal.translationZh: "住房危机"等同于"草地混凝土化"的说法纯粹是游说团体的言论。
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

equal.sentenceEn: BMI equals body mass divided by the square of height.
equal.translationZh: 体重指数等于体重除以身高的平方。
equal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

equal.sentenceEn: After you have clearly and adequately developed the body of your paper, pay particular attention to the introductory and concluding paragraphs. It's probably best to write the introduction last, after you know precisely what you are introducing. Concluding paragraphs demand equal attention because they leave the reader with a final impression.
equal.translationZh: 在清晰且充分地完成论文主体部分后，要特别注意引言和结论段落。最好是在确切知道自己要引入什么内容之后再写引言，也就是把引言留到最后写。结论段落同样需要重点打磨，因为它们会给读者留下最终印象。
equal.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

equally.sentenceEn: And it is equally true that science's unrelenting appetite for information has caused a mushrooming of energy-intensive data centres around the world.
equally.translationZh: 同样真实的是，科学对信息永不满足的渴求已导致全球能源密集型数据中心如雨后春笋般涌现。
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

equally.sentenceEn: Equally , there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
equally.translationZh: 同样，有一种观点认为，东南部通勤者的艰辛——其中许多人将面临最大幅度的票价上涨——获得的关注过多，而相比之下，中部和北部地区那些必须忍受相对落后基础设施的人们却关注不足。
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

equally.sentenceEn: Each spouse retains whatever property he or she brought into the marriage, and jointly-acquired property is divided equally .
equally.translationZh: 夫妻双方各自保留婚前带入婚姻的所有财产，婚后共同获得的财产则平均分配。
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

equally.sentenceEn: The relationship was also stronger in places where happiness was spread more equally .
equally.translationZh: 在幸福感分布更为均衡的地区，这种关联也更为紧密。
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

equally.sentenceEn: Equally unsurprisingly, only about half end up with professorships for which they entered graduate school.
equally.translationZh: 同样不足为奇的是，最终获得教授职位的人仅占当初进入研究生院深造人数的一半左右，而这正是他们攻读研究生学位的初衷。

equally.sentenceEn: Equally , in poetry, the highly personal, performative genre is the only form that could claim real liveliness.
equally.translationZh: 同样，在诗歌领域，高度个人化、富有表现力的风格成为了唯一能够体现真正活力的形式。
equally.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

exposure.sentenceEn: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure .
exposure.translationZh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

exposure.sentenceEn: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
exposure.translationZh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

exposure.sentenceEn: Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants' eating habits and students' video exposure .
exposure.translationZh: 目前，研究人员正在深入探究教学风格、助教饮食习惯以及学生观看视频情况所产生的具体影响。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

exposure.sentenceEn: During the 1840s and 1850s, in the early days of photography, exposure times were notoriously long: the daguerreotype photographic method (producing an image on a silvered copper plate) could take several minutes to complete, resulting in blurred images as sitters shifted position or adjusted their limbs.
exposure.translationZh: 在19世纪40至50年代，也就是摄影术发展的早期，曝光时间出奇地长：银版照相法（在镀银铜板上成像）可能需要几分钟才能完成，这导致被拍摄者稍微变换姿势或调整肢体就会使影像模糊。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

exposure.sentenceEn: But exposure times were much quicker by the 1880s, and the introduction of the Box Brownie and other portable cameras meant that, though slow by today's digital standards, the exposure was almost instantaneous.
exposure.translationZh: 但到了19世纪80年代，曝光时间已大幅缩短。随着布朗尼盒式相机及其他便携式相机的问世，尽管以如今的数字标准来看仍显缓慢，但曝光已近乎瞬间完成。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

exposure.sentenceEn: They show effects of different exposure times.
exposure.translationZh: 它们展示了不同曝光时间带来的效果。

educated.sentenceEn: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
educated.translationZh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

educated.sentenceEn: However, many leading American universities want their undergraduates to have a grounding in the basic canon of ideas that every educated person should possess.
educated.translationZh: 然而，许多美国顶尖大学都希望本科生能在那些每一位受过教育的人都应掌握的基础思想经典方面打下坚实基础。

educated.sentenceEn: We should not forget, however, that most New Englanders were less well educated .
educated.translationZh: 然而，我们不应忘记，大多数新英格兰人受教育程度并不高。
educated.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
educated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

educated.sentenceEn: Besides the ninety or so learned ministers who came to Massachusetts churches in the decade after 1629, there were political leaders like John Winthrop, an educated gentleman, lawyer, and official of the Crown before he journeyed to Boston.
educated.translationZh: 除了1629年后十年间来到马萨诸塞州各教堂的约90位博学牧师外，还有像约翰·温思罗普这样的政治领袖——在前往波士顿之前，他是一位受过良好教育的绅士、律师，同时也是英国王室官员。
educated.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
educated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

educated.sentenceEn: Not long ago, with the country entering a recession and Japan at its pre-bubble peak, the U.S. workforce was derided as poorly educated and one of the primary causes of the poor U.S. economic performance.
educated.translationZh: 不久前，随着美国经济陷入衰退，而日本正处于泡沫破裂前的巅峰时期，美国劳动力被嘲笑为受教育程度低，且被认为是美国经济表现不佳的主要原因之一。
educated.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
educated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

educated.sentenceEn: Traditionally, legal learning has been viewed in such institutions as the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person.
educated.translationZh: 传统上，在这类院校中，法律知识一直被视为律师的专属领域，而非受过教育者知识素养的必要组成部分。
educated.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
educated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

embrace.sentenceEn: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
embrace.translationZh: 当欲望小径在现实与虚拟空间中纵横交错，它们成为了集体坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的证明。
embrace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

embrace.sentenceEn: But people can't be expected to embrace the changes if they're not seeing the benefits—if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed.
embrace.translationZh: 但是，如果人们看不到变革带来的好处——如果他们只看到好工作在不断消失——那么我们就不能指望他们会欣然接受这些变革。
embrace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

embrace.sentenceEn: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
embrace.translationZh: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然势头强劲，但是，要使合作取得成功，双方都需要投入时间，并乐于接受惊喜与挑战。
embrace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

embrace.sentenceEn: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability.
embrace.translationZh: 该行业押注，那些愿意为散养、非转基因和牧场饲养等优质属性支付更高价格的消费者，同样会欣然接受可持续理念。
embrace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

embrace.sentenceEn: This advice is more relevant now than ever before, even as more parents want to embrace the ideas of their children, despite the current housing crunch.
embrace.translationZh: 尽管当前住房市场形势严峻，但越来越多的父母希望采纳孩子的意见，在这种情况下，上述建议比以往任何时候都更加适用。
embrace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第16段，第1句

embrace.sentenceEn: In order to make the most of our focus and energy, we also need to embrace downtime, or as Newport suggests, "be lazy".
embrace.translationZh: 为了充分利用我们的专注力和精力，我们还需要拥抱休息时间，或者如纽波特所建议的那样——“学会偷懒”。
embrace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

emission.sentenceEn: Thanks to his invention, we have a real chance to decrease the world's carbon emissions .
emission.translationZh: 多亏了他的发明，我们才有真正的机会减少全球碳排放。
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

emission.sentenceEn: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions .
emission.translationZh: 最近得知一些科学家为了减少碳排放而打算缩减研究规模，我感到十分震惊。
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

emission.sentenceEn: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can't track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it's coming from and who's producing it?
emission.translationZh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中的二氧化碳含量、其来源以及排放者，又怎能告知决策者降低碳排放的最佳方法呢？
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

emission.sentenceEn: The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
emission.translationZh: 技术研究产生的碳排放是值得的：这项研究最终将守护我们星球的未来。
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

emission.sentenceEn: The rules, which came into effect on Wednesday in England, are part of government plans to reduce the UK's carbon emissions to net zero by 2050.
emission.translationZh: 这些新规于周三在英格兰生效，是英国政府计划的一部分，旨在到2050年将英国的碳排放降至净零水平。
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

emission.sentenceEn: Even if this program didn't reduce poverty, Ferraro says, "the value of the avoided deforestation just for carbon dioxide emissions alone is more than the program costs."
emission.translationZh: 费拉罗表示，即便该项目未能减轻贫困，"单是在减少二氧化碳排放方面，避免森林砍伐所产生的价值就已超过项目成本。"
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

evolutionary.sentenceEn: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
evolutionary.translationZh: 研究团队重建了这些动物的进化树，并利用计算机模型精准定位了这次驯化事件，即肯尼亚和非洲之角的牧民驯服野驴的时间点。
evolutionary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

evolutionary.sentenceEn: "Donkeys are champions when it comes to carrying stuff and are good at crossing deserts," co-author Ludovic Orlando, an evolutionary biologist at Paul Sabatier University in France, tells the publication.
evolutionary.translationZh: 该研究的共同作者、法国保罗·萨巴蒂尔大学的进化生物学家卢多维克·奥兰多告诉该刊物：“驴在负重方面是冠军，而且非常擅长穿越沙漠。”
evolutionary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

evolutionary.sentenceEn: According to Dr. Nikhil Chaudhary, an evolutionary anthropologist at Cambridge University, these practices, known as alloparenting, could lead to less anxiety for children and parents.
evolutionary.translationZh: 剑桥大学进化人类学家尼克希尔·乔杜里博士表示，这些被称为“异亲抚育”的做法可以减轻孩子和父母的焦虑。
evolutionary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

evolutionary.sentenceEn: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.
evolutionary.translationZh: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》发表的一篇论文中，研究人员指出，西方核心家庭是近代的产物，它打破了人类的进化史。
evolutionary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

evolutionary.sentenceEn: Chaudhary said that parents now had less childcare support from family and social networks than during most of humans' evolutionary history, but introducing additional caregivers could reduce stress and maternal depression, which could have a "knock-on" benefit to a child's wellbeing.
evolutionary.translationZh: 乔杜里指出，与人类进化史的大部分时期相比，如今的父母从家庭和社交网络获得的育儿支持更少。但增加额外的照料者可以减轻压力和母亲抑郁，这可能对孩子的福祉产生'连锁'益处。
evolutionary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

evolutionary.sentenceEn: Plants can't run away from danger, so investing energy in a body system which recognizes a threat and can feel pain would be a very poor evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
evolutionary.translationZh: 文章指出，植物无法逃离危险，因此将能量投入到一个能够识别威胁并感知疼痛的身体系统中，将是一种非常糟糕的进化策略。
evolutionary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

excessive.sentenceEn: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections.
excessive.translationZh: 社会也因过度的就业保护而受到损害。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

excessive.sentenceEn: The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper—printing presses, delivery trucks – isn't just expensive; it's excessive at a time when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints.
excessive.translationZh: 制作实体报纸所需的基础设施——印刷机、送报卡车——不仅成本高昂；在如今这个时代，当纯在线竞争对手无需面对同样的财务限制时，这些设施就显得过于冗余了。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

excessive.sentenceEn: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
excessive.translationZh: 议会还同意禁止那些通过宣扬极端节食来“煽动过度瘦身”的网站。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

excessive.sentenceEn: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.
excessive.translationZh: 其一是法律教育的成本过高。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

excessive.sentenceEn: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as smoking or excessive drinking.
excessive.translationZh: 英国皇家儿科与儿童健康学院院长特伦斯·斯蒂芬森教授表示，食用不健康食品的危害应被视为与吸烟或过量饮酒同样严重。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

excessive.sentenceEn: Excessive emphasis has been placed on the basics.
excessive.translationZh: 人们过分强调基础知识。
excessive.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

extension.sentenceEn: "An average extension will probably see around £3,000 additional cost thanks to the new regs."
extension.translationZh: “由于新规，一个普通的扩建项目可能会增加约3000英镑的成本。”
extension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第4句

extension.sentenceEn: "There are new rules concerning the amount of glazing used in extensions , and any new windows or doors must be highly insulated."
extension.translationZh: 新规对扩建部分的玻璃使用量作出了规定，而且所有新安装的门窗都必须具备高度的隔热性能。
extension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

extension.sentenceEn: New building regulations aimed at improving energy efficiency are set to increase the price of new homes, as well as those of extensions and loft conversions on existing ones.
extension.translationZh: 旨在提高能源效率的新建筑法规将推高新房价格，同时也会增加现有住房扩建和阁楼改建的成本。
extension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

extension.sentenceEn: Thomas Goodman, of MyJobQuote, says this will bring in new restrictions for extensions .
extension.translationZh: MyJobQuote网站的托马斯·古德曼表示，这将为房屋扩建带来新的限制。
extension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

extension.sentenceEn: Enraged by Entergy's behavior, the Vermont Senate voted 26 to 4 last year against allowing an extension .
extension.translationZh: 安特吉公司的行为激怒了佛蒙特州参议院，后者于去年以26票对4票否决了其延期运营的请求。
extension.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

extension.sentenceEn: The new rules will affect people whose home extensions include new windows or doors.
extension.translationZh: 新规将影响那些在房屋扩建中包含新窗户或新门的业主。

extreme.sentenceEn: Researchers analysed the frequency and impact of gaps greater than 2 seconds during conversations, including an overview of previous studies which indicate that the fear of awkward silences can be so extreme that people avoid talking to strangers, even though doing so is likely to be an enjoyable experience.
extreme.translationZh: 研究人员分析了对话中超过2秒的停顿频率及其影响，包括对先前研究的综述。这些研究表明，人们对尴尬沉默的恐惧可能非常强烈，以至于会避免与陌生人交谈，尽管这样的交谈很可能是一次愉快的体验。
extreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

extreme.sentenceEn: Travellers on the Silk Road faced the possibility of being attacked by thieves or being subjected to extreme weather conditions.
extreme.translationZh: 丝绸之路上的旅人面临着被强盗袭击或遭遇极端天气的风险。
extreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

extreme.sentenceEn: The weather in Texas may have cooled since the recent extreme heat, but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting in Austin this month as officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools.
extreme.translationZh: 得克萨斯州的天气自近期极端高温后或许已有所降温，但本月在奥斯汀举行的州教育委员会会议上气氛将持续升温——官员们正就该州学校如何教授气候变化展开辩论。
extreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

extreme.sentenceEn: Just 23 per cent of the fruit and vegetables consumed in the UK are currently home-grown, so even with the most extreme measures we could meet only 30 per cent of our fresh produce needs.
extreme.translationZh: 目前英国消费的水果和蔬菜中仅23%是本土种植的，因此即使采取最极端的措施，我们也只能满足30%的新鲜农产品需求。
extreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

extreme.sentenceEn: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
extreme.translationZh: 议会还同意禁止那些通过宣扬极端节食来“煽动过度瘦身”的网站。
extreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

extreme.sentenceEn: Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
extreme.translationZh: 贝多芬习惯将音量增强到极致强度，然后突然转入一段轻柔的乐段，这种手法在他之前的作曲家作品中极为罕见。
extreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

earlier.sentenceEn: This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier , and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, she says.
earlier.translationZh: 她说，这可能会让老鼠更好地记住自己之前释放过社交机器人，并希望在自己被困时机器人能回报这份恩情。
earlier.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

earlier.sentenceEn: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
earlier.translationZh: 如果律师资格考试对于准律师而言确实是足够严格的测试，那么就应该允许那些能够提前参加考试的人这样做。
earlier.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

earlier.sentenceEn: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign, which included efforts to engage with consumers directly on sites such as Twitter and the social-news site Digg.
earlier.translationZh: 例如，丰田汽车公司在今年早些时候的召回危机中，通过一场相对迅速且精心策划的社交媒体响应活动，减轻了部分损失。该活动包括在Twitter和社交新闻网站Digg等平台上直接与消费者互动。
earlier.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

earlier.sentenceEn: Earlier this year the country's Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.
earlier.translationZh: 今年早些时候，美国国防高级研究计划局宣布计划资助波音公司研究编队飞行技术，不过该项目尚未启动。
earlier.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

earlier.sentenceEn: At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics, a research firm – double the figure five years earlier .
earlier.translationZh: 研究公司Arts Economics的创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁（Clare McAndrew）估计，在2007年的顶峰时期，艺术品市场价值约650亿美元，是五年前的两倍。
earlier.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

earlier.sentenceEn: Only a decade earlier , such an act would have required legislative approval in Virginia.
earlier.translationZh: 而仅仅在十年前，在弗吉尼亚州，这样的行为还需要获得立法机构的批准。
earlier.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
earlier.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

economics.sentenceEn: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress.
economics.translationZh: 剑桥大学经济学家黛安娜·科伊尔在其新书《齿轮与怪兽：经济学是什么，应该是什么》中指出，数字经济需要我们以新的方式思考进步。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

economics.sentenceEn: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine.
economics.translationZh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学布兰德万恩分校农业经济学副教授朱莉·斯坦顿表示，再生农业产品可能很难推广，因为这个概念难以快速定义。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

economics.sentenceEn: He quotes a giant of classical economics , Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
economics.translationZh: 他引用古典经济学巨匠阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的话，将这种金融上的急躁行为描述为像“孩子们把布丁里的梅子挑出来立刻吃掉”，而不是把它们留到最后再吃。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

economics.sentenceEn: At its peak in 2007 it was worth some $65 billion, reckons Clare McAndrew, founder of Arts Economics , a research firm – double the figure five years earlier.
economics.translationZh: 研究公司Arts Economics的创始人克莱尔·麦克安德鲁（Clare McAndrew）估计，在2007年的顶峰时期，艺术品市场价值约650亿美元，是五年前的两倍。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

economics.sentenceEn: In just one generation, millions of mothers have gone to work, transforming basic family economics .
economics.translationZh: 仅仅一代人的时间里，数百万母亲步入职场，彻底改变了家庭的基本经济状况。
economics.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

economics.sentenceEn: Basic economics suggests the greater the potential consumers, the higher the likelihood of a better price.
economics.translationZh: 基础经济学原理表明，潜在消费者越多，获得更优惠价格的可能性就越大。
economics.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

electricity.sentenceEn: According to the International Energy Agency, these buildings now consume about 1 per cent of the world's electricity .
electricity.translationZh: 根据国际能源署的数据，这些建筑目前消耗约占全球1%的电力。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

electricity.sentenceEn: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
electricity.translationZh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

electricity.sentenceEn: However, the signaling in a plant is only superficially similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity ," Taiz said.
electricity.translationZh: 然而，泰兹指出，植物体内的信号传导与复杂动物大脑中的神经冲动只是表面相似，而动物大脑远不止是'一团通过电流进行交流的细胞'。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

electricity.sentenceEn: Energy companies can use AI to help customers reduce their electricity bills, saving them money while helping the environment.
electricity.translationZh: 能源公司可以利用人工智能帮助客户降低电费，在为客户省钱的同时也有利于环境保护。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

electricity.sentenceEn: Companies can also optimize their own energy use and cut down on the cost of electricity .
electricity.translationZh: 企业还能优化自身的能源使用，降低电力成本。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

electricity.sentenceEn: In Scotland, for example, wind turbines provide enough electricity to power 95 percent of homes.
electricity.translationZh: 例如在苏格兰，风力涡轮机产生的电力足以满足95%家庭的用电需求。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

engagement.sentenceEn: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
engagement.translationZh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

engagement.sentenceEn: Recent decades have seen science move into a convention where engagement in the subject can only be done through institutions such as a university.
engagement.translationZh: 近几十年来，科学界逐渐形成了一种惯例：只有通过大学等机构才能参与科学研究。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

engagement.sentenceEn: Citizen science provides an opportunity for greater public engagement and the democratisation of science.
engagement.translationZh: 公民科学为公众更广泛参与和科学民主化提供了机会。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

engagement.sentenceEn: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement .
engagement.translationZh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校2014年在澳大利亚、英国和美国开展的一项调查发现，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖提高了他们的政治参与度。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

engagement.sentenceEn: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
engagement.translationZh: 该研究不再仅仅关注国内生产总值，而是衡量了来自健康、教育和公民社会参与等方面的40多组不同标准，以便更全面地评估各国的表现。
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

engagement.sentenceEn: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement . It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine."
engagement.translationZh: 詹妮·拉德斯基在其关于数字娱乐的研究中指出：“科技产品的设计初衷就是为了牢牢吸引你的注意力，而数字产品的存在就是为了促使用户尽可能长时间地使用。这使得人们难以从中抽离，并大量渗透到家庭日常生活中。”
engagement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

entrepreneur.sentenceEn: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs .
entrepreneur.translationZh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
entrepreneur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

entrepreneur.sentenceEn: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit, you need to find a way to take it to the next level.
entrepreneur.translationZh: 以下是当今众多创业者共同面临的一种常见情况：你是一家小型企业的首席执行官，尽管企业盈利可观，但你需要找到方法将其提升到一个新的水平。
entrepreneur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

entrepreneur.sentenceEn: The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, "Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision."
entrepreneur.translationZh: 小企业与创业委员会这一倡导组织在一份声明中表示：'这一裁决完全不利于小企业和互联网创业者。'
entrepreneur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

entrepreneur.sentenceEn: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
entrepreneur.translationZh: 在过去技术发生剧烈变革的时代，企业家们通过想出将劳动力与机器结合的方法，推动了这一转型过程。
entrepreneur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

entrepreneur.sentenceEn: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
entrepreneur.translationZh: 俗话说，品位是买不来的。同样，这些暴发户企业家也无法为他们设立的奖项买来诺贝尔奖那样的声望。
entrepreneur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

entrepreneur.sentenceEn: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs .
entrepreneur.translationZh: 其中许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，其资金来源于互联网企业家们巨额的银行存款。
entrepreneur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

error.sentenceEn: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships.
error.translationZh: 而内疚感通过促使我们更深刻地反思自己的道德品质，可以鼓励人们弥补过失并修复关系。
error.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

error.sentenceEn: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error ," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
error.translationZh: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人认为虚假新闻现象的首要原因是“读者错误”，这一因素超过了虚构故事或报道中的事实错误。
error.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

error.sentenceEn: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
error.translationZh: 细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应懂得如何分析数据，但已发表的研究中统计错误却多得出奇。
error.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

error.sentenceEn: Opportunities for misinterpretation, error , and self-deception abound.
error.translationZh: 误解、犯错和自欺欺人的可能性无处不在。
error.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

error.sentenceEn: Good writing most often occurs when you are in hot pursuit of an idea rather than in a nervous search for errors .
error.translationZh: 优秀的写作往往出现在你热切追寻某个想法时，而非紧张地搜寻错误之际。
error.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
error.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

error.sentenceEn: He points out that he always experienced much difficulty in expressing himself clearly and concisely, but he believes that this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage of forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations.
error.translationZh: 他指出，自己在清晰简洁地表达思想方面总是遇到很大困难，但他认为，正是这种困难反而带来了一种补偿性优势：它迫使他对每一句话都进行长时间专注的思考，从而使他能够发现推理过程和自身观察中的错误。
error.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
error.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

exhibit.sentenceEn: Visit any antiques store and you'll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-65 World's Fair, the ephemera of history.
exhibit.translationZh: 走进任何一家古董店，你都会邂逅往昔的遗物：照片、信件、一本详述1964-1965年世界博览会上辛克莱恐龙展的小册子，以及各种历史短存之物。
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

exhibit.sentenceEn: The context of any exhibit is more important to me than whether the object being displayed is 2,000 years old or 2 months old.
exhibit.translationZh: 对我而言，任何展览的背景信息都比展品本身是有2000年历史还是仅2个月历史更为重要。
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

exhibit.sentenceEn: Again, the story an exhibit is trying to tell is what matters.
exhibit.translationZh: 再说一遍，展览想要讲述的故事才是关键。
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

exhibit.sentenceEn: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
exhibit.translationZh: 她展现出了许多可持续发展倡导者所共有的理想主义，无论是在食品领域还是能源领域。
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

exhibit.sentenceEn: "The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit ," wrote Smiles, "what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself."
exhibit.translationZh: 斯迈尔斯写道：“他们身上所展现的宝贵榜样——自助的力量、坚定的意志、不懈的努力和始终如一的正直品格，最终铸就了真正高尚而有男子气概的人格——展示了每个人都有能力为自己成就一番事业。”
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

exhibit.sentenceEn: A student who exhibits abilities in doing business can impress colleges.
exhibit.translationZh: 展现出经商才能的学生往往能给大学留下深刻印象。

existing.sentenceEn: But implementation of existing HAPs has been uneven, according to a report from the Centre for Policy Research.
existing.translationZh: 但政策研究中心的一份报告显示，现有健康行动计划的实施情况参差不齐。
existing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

existing.sentenceEn: New building regulations aimed at improving energy efficiency are set to increase the price of new homes, as well as those of extensions and loft conversions on existing ones.
existing.translationZh: 旨在提高能源效率的新建筑法规将推高新房价格，同时也会增加现有住房扩建和阁楼改建的成本。
